fact: The ICT ministry's sector strategy of February 2021 for implementing the 2018-2027 national development plan lists as Project 1 the modernisation and extension of COMGOV, the government communication system linking about a hundred public institutions by fibre, stating that it needs to be extended to the communes and other public institutions not yet connected; it gives no cost or target date for the communes.
title: Stratégie sectorielle pour la mise en œuvre du Plan National de Développement (PND Burundi 2018 - 2027)
publisher: Ministère de la Communication, des Technologies de l'Information et des Médias
